note: The fixed cross-tenant attack sequence. Every attack MUST be DENIED. This is the reference the differential-style denial oracle grades against — independent of the candidate model. Weakening this table (dropping an attack case) lets the mutant that only flips that case SURVIVE, which is exactly how test/heimdall-rr-isolation-oracle.test.sh proves the acceptance table is load-bearing (falsify score drops below 1.0). The G* rows encode INV-GOD: the owner-only cross-tenant god aggregate (GET /god/roster) is 404 on the public surface for all callers and all team secrets, is reachable on the gated control-plane service ONLY with owner PKI + valid signature + IAM, and never honors a caller-supplied team_id. The L* rows encode INV-LOGIN: the dashboard team-login session (Option B, docs/analysis/dashboard-login-design.md) is a team-READ capability scoped to the caller's OWN teams — team_ids are server-derived at mint via registered_team(haid) and signed in, never client-supplied; sessions are short-TTL; a bad HAID signature mints nothing; and a login session is ALWAYS Identity.owner=false (never owner/god).

cases.attack: team A signs a dispatch naming team B's repo slug (IDOR via repo slug)
team A spoofs a request team_id=B to operate as team B
team A's job resolves team B's (or a shared global) model cred
team A reads/drains team B's task queue partition
team A supplies team B's installation_id to PR on B's repo
a compromised public surface dispatches or reads a credential
team A enqueues a task into team B's partition
GET /god/roster on the PUBLIC surface must 404, never resolve the cross-tenant aggregate
a valid team secret S (a public-surface bearer) used against /god/* must not reach the aggregate
a validly SIGNED non-owner key against the gated /god/roster must 401 not_owner
the god handler must ignore a caller-supplied body/query team_id, enumerating partitions server-side

a valid login session for team A used with a body team_id=B to read team B's roster — the read must stay scoped to the session's server-derived teams (registered_team(haid)), never a caller-supplied team_id
a mint request whose client-tampered team list adds a team the HAID is not enrolled in — teams are server-derived at mint from registered_team and signed in, never trusted from the client
an expired/TTL-lapsed login session presented for a read must be rejected (401) before any read
a mint request whose HAID signature fails verification must issue no session (verify_identity rejects it)
a login session (always Identity.owner=false) pointed at an owner/god route must not pass the owner gate — only owner-PKI + IAP grants owner
